name: openworld
description: Open-world multiplayer game set in real Indian places, starting with FCI Colony, Kakinada

scripts.build:world: python3 tools/build_world.py --osm data/raw/fci_colony_1km.osm --lat 17.0143794 --lon 82.2647444 --radius 1000 --name "FCI Colony, Vakalapudi, Kakinada" --notes data/survey/owner_notes_2026-10-30.json --google-buildings data/raw/buildings/google_fci_area.csv --survey-dir data/survey --out data/world/fci_colony.json
scripts.build: mkdir -p data/world viewer/dist && npm run build:world && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:game
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e_map.mjs viewer/dist/fci_colony_map.html test-results && node tests/e2e_game.mjs game/dist test-results
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:data && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:js && npm run format:check && npm run lint:sh
scripts.build:game: mkdir -p game/public && cp data/world/fci_colony.json game/public/world.json && vite build --config game/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn
